ble.pairing.passkey.says: the node shows a PIN and the phone types it

ai.never_authorizes.says: the visual policy never authorizes an action

battery.write.off_by_default.says: writing to a battery is off unless ARMOR_BATTERY_WRITE=1

alarm.commands.off_by_default.says: alarm commands are off unless ARMOR_ALARM_COMMANDS=1

onvif.same_host.says: an ONVIF address a camera advertises must stay on the configured host

camera.redirects.refused.says: the requests to a camera refuse HTTP redirects

webhooks.no_redirect.says: alarm webhooks do not follow redirects

remote.session.limits.says: a session from outside lasts 12 hours and 30 minutes without use

discovery.private_24.pattern: camera discovery only scans private networks[\s\S]{0,600}
discovery.private_24.says: camera discovery scans only a private IPv4 /24

discovery.one_at_a_time.pattern: a camera discovery is already running
discovery.one_at_a_time.says: only one camera discovery runs at a time

login.rate_limited.says: sign-in is limited per person and place, per place and for the whole server

sessions.bounded.says: the number of live sessions is bounded

tickets.bounded.says: live-video tickets last five minutes and at most 256 exist

studio.password.min_length.says: a Studio password is at least 12 characters on a server the network reaches

user.pin.lock_steps.says: three wrong PINs lock a user for a minute, then five, then fifteen

node.pause.bounds.says: a pause lasts 60 to 3600 seconds, an hour when none is said

node.maintenance.bounds.says: maintenance lasts 60 to 28800 seconds, an hour when none is said

diagnostic.token.ttl.says: a diagnostic token lasts 5 minutes to 24 hours, 2 hours when none is said

diagnostic.token.max_active.says: at most twenty diagnostic tokens are active at a time

http.body.limit.says: an ordinary request body over 64 kb is refused

login.rate_limits.says: twelve Studio login tries in fifteen minutes for each person and place, sixty for each place

studio.session.ttl.says: a Studio session lasts seven days by default

machine_update.off_by_default.says: updating the programs of the machine from Studio or the phone is off unless ARMOR_CM5_UPDATE=1

machine_update.min_interval.says: the server accepts at most one update of the machine every five minutes

machine_update.plan_ttl.says: the plan of an update handed out by the preview is good for five minutes

machine_update.admin_elevated.says: applying an update needs an administrator and a fresh proof of identity
